As established practitioners, they mentor junior team members and shape best practices across the region.

As a subject matter expert, the HR Partner mentors and guides junior team members.

At OpenAI, we’re here to do something extraordinary: build safe AGI that benefits everyone. That mission demands people who are not just brilliant but also deeply aligned with our values.  - Build and execute proactive, data-informed sourcing strategies to attract high-calibre and diverse talent across competitive markets.

 - Act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers, driving alignment, challenging assumptions, and maintaining a consistently high hiring bar.

 - Deliver an exceptional candidate experience, ensuring every interaction reflects OpenAI’s values and mission.

 - Navigate complex, global hiring environments by partnering with People, Legal, and Compens
